explanation: The response only overlaps at the broad category of high-entropy materials. It misses the target composition, SPS processing window, 900 °C oxidation and 3.5 wt% NaCl corrosion conditions, oxide-mediated dense microstructure, and all quantitative outcomes. Its baseline and falsification experiment are coherent for catalyst evaluation but are irrelevant to the requested lightweight structural material and cannot distinguish the target hypothesis. The citations support some generic catalytic claims, but not lightweight comprehensive performance or the claimed structural-property relationship.
